limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
implementation: Five-bit right-shifting Galois LFSR with feedback at positions 5 and 3 and active-high synchronous reset to 1.
verification: Independent integer shift/XOR oracle, all 31 nonzero states without early repetition, seed recurrence, repeated cycles, reset held across edges, and reset assertion between edges. Bounded timeout and explicit PASS output.
